natural_language_statement: AllPositiveConverge is equivalent both to UniversalDescent and to UniversalSmallerCoalescence. The latter requires, for every n>1, a positive m<n and r,s in Nat such that T^r(n)=T^s(m). Converges means an actual finite shortcut iterate reaches 1. Convergence is preserved by finite prefixes and by coalescence. Limitations: These are induction criteria and semantic equivalences. UniversalSmallerCoalescence and UniversalDescent are not proved; each is Collatz-equivalent. The map keeps the cycle 1->2->1 rather than making 1 absorbing. No novelty claim for the criteria.
